transcript: "Excuse me, where is the National Gallery? Walk straight on for two minutes. At the lights, turn right. The gallery is on your left, opposite a small cafe."

label: Text 2
transcript: "On her London trip Mia saw Big Ben, the London Eye, Tower Bridge, and the British Museum. Her favourite was the London Eye, because the view was amazing. Theo's favourite was the museum."
